name: Adaeze Okonkwo
bio: Adaeze brings over 12 years of luxury real estate experience across Lagos's most prestigious addresses. Her deep market knowledge and client-first approach have made her one of Lagos's most trusted property advisors.

name: Emeka Nwosu
bio: Emeka specialises in ultra-high-net-worth transactions on Banana Island and Ikoyi. His legal and architectural background gives clients an unmatched level of due diligence and deal structuring expertise.

name: Fatima Al-Hassan
bio: Fatima leads our Abuja operations with a focus on the diplomatic and government residential corridors of Asokoro, Maitama, and Wuse 2. Her network spans embassies, government agencies, and the city's top developers.

name: Chukwudi Eze
bio: Chukwudi handles commercial acquisitions and mixed-use developments across Lagos Island and the Eko Atlantic City development. His portfolio includes some of Nigeria's most high-profile commercial transactions.
